claim: the only KoW Battlesmith Guide (2003-07-13, iRO) documents that becoming a Blacksmith required no quest and no fee upon reaching Job Level 40
value: Head inside and become a Blacksmith; it's that simple.  No paying, no quest, no nothing.
quote: Head to south-western Geffen, the building with smoke rising from it in the very corner.  Head inside and become a Blacksmith; it's that simple.  No paying, no quest, no nothing.
reasoning: FAQ 24428 section 3 The Battlesmith Is Born confirms Blacksmith job change had no test or quest in July 2003 on iRO
